content: Results versioning practices: HELM (live-verified) maintains CHANGELOG.md and a 'Reproducing Leaderboards' doc that pins each public leaderboard release to named run_entries_*.conf and schema_*.yaml files so any leaderboard version can be recreated (helm-run, helm-summarize, helm-server). Open LLM Leaderboard v1-to-v2 (June 2024, training-knowledge consistent across sources): v1 archived/frozen with explicit warning that v1 and v2 scores are not comparable (different benchmark suite IFEval/BBH/MATH/GPQA/MuSR/MMLU-Pro + 0-100 normalization), methodology change announced via blog, community flagging/re-evaluation features; MATH and MuSR later dropped over contamination; leaderboard retired 2025 citing saturation/contamination. Lesson: explicit non-comparability statements and archived old versions are the norm when methodology changes alter numbers.
